title: Luscious Charred Moroccan Shungiku Couscous Royal
description: A charred, tender, and indulgent Moroccan dish featuring shungiku, made with a brine-dry method and diabetic-friendly ingredients, formed into a royal couscous dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the shungiku and cut it into 1-inch pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shungiku to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the shungiku marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Spread the shungiku on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until charred.
Prepare the couscous according to package instructions.
Fluff the cooked couscous with a fork and stir in the roasted shungiku.
Serve the couscous hot, garnished with additional lemon juice and olive oil if desired.
